KFZ.title: Covered vehicle damage
KFZ.text: Synthetic demo clause: covered accidental vehicle damage may be considered when the policy is active and required evidence is present.

KFZ.title: Liability evidence
KFZ.text: Synthetic demo clause: liability assessment requires consistent incident facts and available third-party evidence.

KFZ.title: Repair evidence
KFZ.text: Synthetic demo clause: repair amounts should be checked against supplied estimate or invoice evidence before settlement.

PHV.title: Third-party liability
PHV.text: Synthetic demo clause: covered third-party damage requires a supported liability basis and no identified exclusion.

PHV.title: Disputed liability
PHV.text: Synthetic demo clause: disputed or contradictory liability facts require expert review.

PHV.title: Evidence completeness
PHV.text: Synthetic demo clause: material missing evidence blocks final handling until clarified.

PET.title: Treatment coverage
PET.text: Synthetic demo clause: eligible treatment may be considered when policy timing and treatment evidence are supported.

PET.title: Treatment documentation
PET.text: Synthetic demo clause: incomplete treatment or policy timing evidence requires clarification or review.

HSR.title: Household loss
HSR.text: Synthetic demo clause: covered household loss requires a supported insured event and documented ownership or damage.

HSR.title: Replacement evidence
HSR.text: Synthetic demo clause: material invoice or valuation mismatch requires review.

ELK.title: Electronics damage
ELK.text: Synthetic demo clause: accidental electronics damage may be considered when device and incident evidence are consistent.

ELK.title: Purchase evidence
ELK.text: Synthetic demo clause: purchase and repair evidence must be internally consistent.

REI.title: Travel disruption
REI.text: Synthetic demo clause: covered travel disruption requires an eligible event and supporting booking or cancellation evidence.

REI.title: Travel evidence
REI.text: Synthetic demo clause: missing critical booking or cancellation evidence blocks final handling.
